text:
eva: Heads-upplanning a small SI onboarding beta focused on marketplace packaging + on-prem kit inventory. Quick sync 9am PT tomorrow. Can folks make it?

noah: I can. Main asks: kit inventory counts, cost per kit, and a lightweight cert checklist for sellers vs trainers.

chloe: Proposed checklist (short): 1) quickstart deploy (TF/Helm) 2) smoke generate + GPU check 3) image SHAs pinned 4) docs + runbook uploaded. Sellers get "marketplace-ready" once green.

arnav: Ops note: we have 12 kits available across NA/EU this quarter. Cost estimate $1.25k/kit shipped. Ops requires PO at least 7 days before ship.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Ticket PARTN-477 opened to reserve 6 kits for beta cohort; expires in 10 days.

noah: Beta plan: target 3 SIs, 2-week onboarding window, remote sandbox for non-shippable regions. Measure deploy time and first-pass success.

chloe: For trainer certification, add a short live demo requirement (or recorded deploy + live telemetry check). Also require a post-training evaluation form.

eva: Marketing/PR: we will do a private announcement to participating SIs after pilot success. Partnerships will draft a short marketplace blurb and approved logos.

arnav: Air-gap flow: must include signed tarballs and a manifest pinning step. I can add a small script to generate tarball + checksum.

noah: Can someone author the smoke test we drop in the appendix? Keep tiny.

chloe: I'll add the smoke snippet and upload to the playbook. Quick snippet:

chloe: ```bash
export TOKEN=$SANDBOX_TOKEN
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","input":"hello"}' | jq .
ssh kit 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv'
```

eva: Timeline: checklist + playbook appendix by Tue EOD (chloe), kit reservation confirmed (arnav), pilot invite + intake form by Wed (noah). I'll send the calendar.

noah: Thanks all. Posting pre-read link in the invite. If you can't make 9am ping here and I'll share notes. :thumbsup:
